Subject: Redwood + Finovate: exec workshop — dates and timezone options

Hi Anita / Tom,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to get the two-day executive workshop locked in. We want to make this as smooth as possible for both the London exec team and the SF VPs who will join remotely. Proposed options below:

Option A (preferred by Finovate ops): 14–15 Jul, London onsite (main sessions 09:00–17:00 BST both days) with SF joining remotely for 15:00–17:00 BST (08:00–10:00 PDT)
Option B: 21–22 Jul, hybrid with some breakout sessions repeated to accommodate timezones (09:00–16:00 BST / 01:00–08:00 PDT staggered)

Asks from our side to finalize logistics:
- Please confirm which option (A or B) you prefer and final headcount (onsite vs remote)
- Any travel preferences / restrictions for your execs (airline, hotel class, dietary) — attached is a quick travel preferences form
- Any compliance or procurement requirements (PO number, invoicing contact)

Attached: draft_agenda_v1.pdf, travel_preferences_form.xlsx (fill and return)

I’ll hold provisional calendar blocks for both options on our side until we hear back (48-hour soft hold). If Option A works, we’ll start a hotel room block and confirm AV requirements with the venue.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through if useful.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks — Option A (14–15 Jul) looks best for the London execs. A couple of notes:

- SF VPs can join remotely but will only be available 15:00–17:00 BST on the second day, so please plan the customer ROI discussion and exec Q&A in that window.
- Procurement needs a preliminary cost estimate and PO to start travel approvals; I’ve CC’d procurement. They typically require a 30-day lead time for larger bookings.

I’ll return the travel_preferences_form.xlsx by Thursday — most execs prefer direct flights and the Marriott Grosvenor for proximity.

Also — can we get a short pre-read (1–2 pages) summarizing goals and expected outcomes for each session? That will help our leadership prep.

Best,

Subject: Re: Redwood + Finovate: onsite AV / room requirements

Hi all — quick technical note from the delivery side so we can avoid last-minute surprises on day 1:

Venue requirements we recommend:
- Main room: theatre or boardroom layout for 30 people with a central AV console
- Reliable internet: minimum 10 Mbps upstream sustained for streaming (we’ll need to livestream breakout sessions to SF)
- Wired HDMI + at least 2 USB-C adapters on-site; bring a spare Mac mini for local demos
- Microphones: 2 wireless lapel mics + 2 handhelds for Q&A
- Whiteboard + post-it station for breakout exercises

Onsite contact: please confirm a building/venue contact and arrival window for the Redwood AV tech (we aim to set up 3 hours before the first session).

Attaching a short AV spec we send to venues: onsite_av_spec.pdf

Thanks — Dylan
Solutions & Delivery, Redwood Inference
